attchmntText: Laser Power & Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of Approval for Reclassification of Promoter Group under Regulation 31A of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Laser Power & Infra Limited received approval from the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 12, 2026, for the reclassification of Chaitak Sales Private Limited and Dailmer Industries Private Limited from the Promoter Group category to the Public category under Regulation 31A of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Both entities hold a zero percent shareholding in the company. The approvals were granted in response to the company's application dated September 28, 2026. The stock exchanges issued no-objection letters on November 12, 2026. The company has enclosed the approval letters and stated that the information is available on its website at www.laserpowerinfra.com. The Chairman and Managing Director, Deepak Goel, signed the intimation on behalf of the company.

attchmntText: Laser Power & Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about re-appointment of Chairman and Managing Director for period of five years with effect from 01st January 2027
voiceSummary: Laser Power & Infra Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved the re-appointment of Mr. Deepak Goel, DIN 00673430, as Chairman and Managing Director for five years starting 1st January 2027. This re-appointment is subject to shareholder approval via Postal Ballot. The Board also adopted a policy for determining the materiality of events or information. The meeting concluded at 7:30 P.M. on 12th November 2026. Financial results and the Limited Review Report by M/s. V. Singhi & Associates are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Laser Power & Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Laser Power and Infra Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited on 12th November 2026. The company has a total order book of Rs. 27,844 mn, comprising Rs. 14,327 mn in manufacturing and Rs. 13,557 mn in EPC. Installed capacity stands at 85,448 MT as of Fiscal 2026. Revenue from operations for Fiscal 2026 was Rs. 23,261 mn. EBITDA for Fiscal 2026 was Rs. 3,017 mn with a margin of 13.0%. Profit after tax was Rs. 1,192 mn with a margin of 5.1%. The company completed its initial public offering and listed on BSE and NSE on 16th July 2026. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Laser Power & Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Laser Power and Infra Limited disclosed that there was no deviation or variation in the utilization of proceeds raised through its Initial Public Offer during the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company raised Rs. 5,420.00 million via the IPO, with an allotment date of 14th July 2026. CRISIL Ratings Limited serves as the monitoring agency. The statement confirms that funds were utilized strictly in accordance with the original objects disclosed in the prospectus. No comments were recorded by the audit committee or auditors regarding the use of funds. The disclosure was submitted pursuant to Regulation 32(1) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. Deepak Goel, Chairman and Managing Director, signed the disclosure on 12th November 2026.

attchmntText: Laser Power & Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Laser Power & Infra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Press Release on the Financial Results of the Company, for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026".
voiceSummary: Laser Power and Infra Limited disclosed financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 6,282 Mn, up 2.1% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 759 Mn with a margin of 12.1%. Profit after tax was Rs. 306 Mn, with a PAT margin of 4.9%. For H1 FY27, revenue was Rs. 11,498 Mn, up 7.5% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 1,417 Mn with a margin of 12.3%. Profit after tax was Rs. 517 Mn, with a PAT margin of 4.5%. The order book stood at Rs. 25,426 Mn. The company reported its first commercial HTLS conductor order from POWERGRID and its first 220 kV underground transmission project from CESC. Deepak Goel serves as Chairman and Managing Director with DIN-00673430.

attchmntText: Laser Power & Infra Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Laser Power and Infra Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call to discuss financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The event is set for Friday, 13th November 2026, at 11:00 AM India Time. The meeting will be conducted via dial-in audio conference. Key representatives include Chairman and Managing Director Deepak Goel and Chief Financial Officer Amit Kumar Goel. Participants can join using universal access numbers for India, Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK, and the USA. Registration is available through a provided link. The discussions will strictly rely on publicly available information, with no unpublished price-sensitive data disclosed. The schedule may change due to exigencies. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
